possible_general_mechanism.status: Plausible source-supported exit-transition race; NOT confirmed for this job.
steps: Apple kern_exit moves an exiting process to the zombie list and sets P_REF_DEAD before later setting p_stat=SZOMB.
proc_find obtains proc_ref_try_fast, which refuses P_REF_DEAD; pgrp_iterate skips a candidate when proc_find returns no process.
killpg1 returns POSIX EPERM when the group exists but no member was found/signalable.
waitid reports WEXITED for p_stat=SZOMB. Between P_REF_DEAD and SZOMB, a group signal can therefore have no visible target while a single nonblocking wait observes no completed exit.
The owner immediately rejects that unproven state instead of allowing the already-started exit to become waitable within its remaining original deadline.
proof_limits: The inspected Apple repository default-branch blobs are pinned in the companion evidence, but are not established as the exact XNU source shipped in runner build24H232.
The job did not retain waitid result, census return size/PIDs/errno, ctypes failure, or timing of the classification.
A real permission denial, interrupted wait or failed/inconsistent census cannot be excluded from this log alone.
The passing real singleton control proves only its own later invocation, not the failing output-cap invocation.

minimal_patch_candidate_not_applied.target: Only Darwin PermissionError classification in bounded_process.py; retain all existing signal/ownership/census constraints.
outline: Allow the classifier to receive the existing absolute deadline; do not create a new grace deadline.

If the nonreaping wait says pending (None), perform a bounded wait for WEXITED using WNOHANG|WNOWAIT under the original deadline. Do not call poll/wait and release the leader before the final group signal/ownership decision.

After exact PID and accepted exit status are observed, execute the existing strict libproc singleton census unchanged: exactly4 bytes, the owned leader PID, errno0, no extra/foreign/truncated/empty result.

If already exited, keep the immediate existing proof path; if unavailable, mismatched or unresolved at the deadline, preserve a failed cleanup outcome and original PermissionError instead of declaring success.
Retain diagnostic identity for the original cap failure and the cleanup refusal separately; never turn an unproven cleanup into a successful ProcessFailure control merely by swallowing EPERM.
risks_and_limits: This is a design recommendation, not an executed or verified patch.

Waiting on a genuinely live permission-denied child could consume the remaining original budget. The pre-existing unconditional final child.wait is itself not a hard real-time guarantee; the proposal does not resolve that broader issue.
A different helper refusal cause would require a different correction; adding arbitrary sleep or retry alone cannot establish ownership.
required_followup_controls_not_executed: Pure controlled None-to-exited wait transition followed by exact singleton census, with no reaping before proof.
Pending through the unchanged deadline refuses; no new timeout budget and no unbounded helper polling.
Wrong PID/nonexit/reaped leader/library failure/errno/non-singleton/foreign/truncated census all remain refused.
